product.name: Monoprice Super VGA (SVGA) M/F Monitor Cable with Ferrite Cores Gold Plated 3ft
product.description: Extend your SVGA monitor cable using this Super VGA Monitor Extension Cable from Monoprice!This double-shielded cable is designed to handle analog VGA and extended VGA resolutions. It features a male DE-15 (aka HD-15 or DB-15) connector on one end and a female DE-15 connector on the other end. Each heavy-duty connector head includes thumbscrews for securing the plug to a panel connector. It includes ferrite cores at each end, which ensure that EMI and RFI interference will not enter your video system.Updated Sep 4, 2019  Support Files: Diagram (Mar 11, 2026)Warning: This product can expose you to chemicals including Phthalates, which is known to the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm. For more information go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
